_meta.status: 1 part landed (skull mask, proof piece #1) 2026-10-21 via the W6 piecewise lane; the full-set named gap below remains open — the rest of the item tree is extracted chunk-wise from the same source (see the survey §3 route, updated by the W6 lane report: source = archive.org T7VHDsExtracted loose tree, piecewise range/7z-folder method). || 2026-11-08 (hair-wiring lane): 33 hair items landed in parts[] from the held GRE Steam teardown (31 HAIR + 2 FACE_HAIR), each with its real GLB(s) + held texture maps + measured swing-bone physics metadata (game/js/hair-spring.js). Item names use the character names recorded in the held docs; codes arb/bs7/dnc/frv/ltn/mut are unresolved in held docs and kept as codes (never guessed).
_meta.suite_slot_mapping: T7 slot -> suite_slot: HEAD->head, HAIR->hair, FULL_HEAD->full_head, HAIR_ACC->hair_acc, GLA->glasses, FACE->face, FACE_HAIR->face_hair, MAKE_UP->make_up (texture_part), UPPER->upper_body, FULL_BODY->full_body, LOWER->lower_body, UPPER_ACC->upper_acc, LOWER_ACC->lower_acc, EXTRA->extra, Effects->effect, Aura->aura. Scope: in-pak mesh folder 'cmn' = generic (PlayerCus 0); a character-abbreviation folder = that character's parts (charId per tekken7-slot-catalog.json).

conversion.source_format: UE4 .uasset (loose extracted game tree, NOT paks): TekkenGame/Content/Character/Item/Meshes/cmn/Full_Head/cmn_hef_skull/{Meshes,Texture,Material} — Tekken 7 Fated Retribution (Namco System ES3 arcade build) tree, archive.org item T7VHDsExtracted, file 'TR205 Extracted.7z', folder 0. The generic item's per-character fitted variant SK_CH_dra_hef_skull (Dragunov) is the converted mesh — the same skeleton Slice's Attire 1 binds; all 43 SK variants + MI + 4 textures were extracted (48 .uasset, 8.0MB, UE magic C1 83 2A 9E verified) and are stored in release w6-tekken7-parts-20261021 (skull-mask-uassets.zip, sha256 in the PR).
conversion.tool: umodel_linux (held build 1578, from tekken7-full-v1) -export -gltf + TGAs -> Blender 4.0.2 material bind per the game's own MI_CH_cmn_hef_skull (Diffuse=D, Normal=N, SpecPower=R, Metallic scalar 0.45) -> GLB, stray umodel Icosphere helper removed
conversion.proof: customization/parts/tekken7/full_head/skull-mask/proof-on-slice.png — mask on Slice Attire 1 (Dragunov), beret hidden (FULL_HEAD equip semantics), viewed by the lane
conversion.notes: color_slots RESOLVED 2026-10-22 (W6b): CCI_dra_hef_skull + CI_dra_hef_skull extracted piecewise from the same TR205 archive (folder 0) and parsed directly (umodel loads the packages but cannot dump these classes) — color_slots = 4 from CCI ItemColors[0].InstanceColors/ColorIndicies (defaults + palette mapping in customization_records; full parse in records-dra.json; all 39 characters' CCI color records are identical). Placement offsets are 0 because the DRA-fitted mesh is already at head position in Dragunov skeleton space (measured bbox z 1.706..2.037, x/y centered on 0).

customization_records.raw_uassets_release: w6-tekken7-parts-20261021: skull-mask-records-dra.zip (CI+CCI for DRA) and skull-mask-records-all-chars.zip (80 records, 39 characters + DRA suit pair)
customization_records.color_slots_source: CCI.ItemColors[0].InstanceColors (4 FLinearColor) + CCI.ItemColors[0].ColorIndicies (4) + CCI.Index0Colors (4) — this item's colorable material channels; CCI.IndexColors (5) is the shared palette (system max 5 per tekken7-slot-catalog.json), not the item channel count
